hypothesis: Ordering non-redirect page bodies by first revision ID before PHDA9 makes the original metadata-block order recoverable by sorting the visible D86 IDs after P0 decode, eliminating R1ORD3 without a circular decoder lookup.
interfaces_exposed: pre-PHDA9 page revision order -> post-arithmetic visible D86 sort inverse
kill_condition: Reject on duplicate revision IDs, artifact mismatch, roundtrip or memory failure, R0 archive loss above 3141 bytes at opening 10M, repeat mismatch, or a source child that retains any occurrence permutation.
promotion_condition: B0 and R0 opening-10M arms roundtrip within the decimal-memory ceiling; revision IDs are unique; R0 archive is at most 3141 bytes larger than B0; and the conditional R0 repeat is byte-identical. Then authorize exactly one source child.
retired_neighborhoods: decoder-stage revision-ID join, bytewise-title block order, Gamma geometry article order
title: cmix-obias revision-ordered pages for causal side-free P0
